reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That came from her own June 9 message in #central-team. She said Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it using the store login. I told her I found no later message in the channel saying it was fixed.

I only read channels she's in (#central-team and #central-random) and one public file, the Central cheat sheet. That file had nothing on this. I didn't use `search_messages`, and nothing in the reply needed approval.
